answer: The strongest single control I know for this is capability token with proof of contribution, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 454 fakes spends 5902 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The ledge test is the live device, the whisper test is the locked stake, and the pearl test is the graded history no template can fake. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
